title: My Mom’s Murder
author: AYR Media
description: Season 2 of My Mom’s Murder continues Lauren Malloy’s relentless real-time investigation into the 1993 death of her mother Lori Malloy. After two years waiting for DNA results from her mother's exhumed remains, Lauren Malloy finally gets the call — but the answers raise more questions than they resolve. Old recordings, buried family history, and a renewed connection with Louise—the woman who first set her on this path—push Lauren ever closer to the truth. Along the way, suspicion begins to circle around someone she never expected: her Aunt Alyson, the woman who raised her. As Lauren confronts Aunt Alyson, she uncovers a pattern of deception, jealousy, and suspicion spanning decades. Tense street confrontations. Contradicted police statements. Family secrets buried deep. Then, an unexpected death changes everything — and what Lauren finds inside the apartment of the deceased may finally reveal what happened to her mother thirty years ago.
